input_event.content:
**Seven same-shape errors** — used a query with a blind spot, then treated "I didn't see it" as "it doesn't exist":
1. **"三个 backend 全没接"** (actually 2/3; macos-render-sync was already wired at `if(APPLE)` further down the file) — corrected by clocksync-exec
2. **"BBR 从来没追上过 NewReno"** — only read a grep fragment; full `d710a1e8` message says "8239 Mbps with pacing off, 8730 for NewReno". **The USER corrected me** ("我觉得你肯定是记错了")
3. **"问题在 pacer 不在模型"** — refuted by my own later measurement (unpaced spread 78% > paced 16%)
4. **"S-B 的先例指望不上"** — misread which precedent bbr-thinker cited (STARTUP `full_loss_cnt`, not `bw_probe_samples`)
5. **"PQ-KEM 生产零调用"** — grepped `alk_pq_kem` (nonexistent prefix); real prefix `alk_hybrid_kem_` has **31 production call sites**. Corrected by pin-thinker
6. **"全表没有 filetransfer"** — grepped `filetransfer|filecopy`; table says `data.file-transfer` (hyphenated)
7. **"mps-exec 功能半没做"** — `git status --short | grep -v "^??"` filtered out its untracked new files. Corrected by mtu-exec
